answer.en: No, pistachios are best kept away from cats. They are not really toxic, but nuts can cause problems for cats, and eating many pistachios is likely to cause stomach upset.
answer.sl: Ne, pistacij mački raje ne dajajte. Niso zares strupene, vendar oreščki mačkam lahko povzročajo težave, in če jih poje veliko, ji bodo verjetno razdražile želodec.

why.en: The ASPCA says pistachios are not really toxic to animals, but a large number is likely to cause stomach upset. Cats Protection warns that nuts can cause problems for cats, and VCA notes most nuts are very fatty. We use the stricter advice.
why.sl: ASPCA navaja, da pistacije za živali niso zares strupene, vendar večja količina verjetno povzroči razdražen želodec. Cats Protection opozarja, da oreščki mačkam lahko povzročajo težave, VCA pa, da je večina oreščkov zelo mastnih. Upoštevamo strožji nasvet.

en: Seeming unwell or low on energy
sl: Mačka deluje bolna ali brez energije

what_to_do.en: A nut or two is unlikely to be an emergency. Watch for vomiting, diarrhoea or a change in behaviour, and call your vet if your cat seems unwell or ate a lot. If the nuts were salted, flavoured or coated in chocolate, call your vet straight away.
what_to_do.sl: En ali dva oreščka najverjetneje ne pomenita nujnega primera. Bodite pozorni na bruhanje, drisko ali spremembo vedenja in pokličite veterinarja, če se mačka ne počuti dobro ali je pojedla veliko. Če so bili oreščki soljeni, začinjeni ali obliti s čokolado, takoj pokličite veterinarja.

child.en: Pistachios are a people snack. They can upset a cat's tummy, so keep them for yourself.
child.sl: Pistacije so prigrizek za ljudi. Mucki lahko razdražijo trebušček, zato jih obdrži zase.

q.en: Are some nuts worse than others?
q.sl: Ali so nekateri oreščki hujši od drugih?

a.en: Yes. Macadamia nuts are fatty and also toxic to cats, so they are the ones to be most careful with.
a.sl: Da. Makadamije so mastne in za mačke tudi strupene, zato je pri njih potrebna največja previdnost.

sources.quote: We’re not sure why nuts get such a bad rap, but like sweet almonds, pistachios are not really toxic to animals.
That being said, if a pet ingests a large number of  pistachios it is likely to result in stomach upset
Some foods that may seem harmless, such as grapes, nuts or avocado, can also cause problems for cats.
Most nuts are very fatty and can cause vomiting and diarrhea, but macadamia nuts specifically will lead to weakness, tremors and hyperthermia.
Not only are macadamia nuts very fatty, potentially causing pancreatitis, they're also toxic and can cause illness in cats.
